new_results.statement: For a literal singular physical pair B=[[a,c],[c,b]], define H=a v-c u from the full original-coordinate arm rows. If H is nonzero, then ||p_Q||_infinity<=2^(11/4)||H||^(-1/2), with the same coefficient times interval length, retaining arbitrary remaining curvature.

If a literal 3x3 physical principal block P has all three eigenvalues of modulus at least sigma and contains a singular physical 2x2 principal pair, then the full ambient form satisfies ||p_Q||_infinity<=8/sigma and P(Q in I)<=8|I|/sigma. Essential boundedness only.

key_identity: For P=[[a,c,u],[c,b,v],[u,v,d]] with ab=c^2 and the pair oriented so |a|>=|b|, H_3=a v-c u satisfies H_3^2=-a det P. Interlacing gives |a|>=sigma/2, hence |H_3|>=sigma^2/sqrt(2).
